title: Investigations into André Mendonça and Flávio Bolsonaro shake up the political scene.
subtitle: Supreme Federal Court Justice reports on high-profile cases involving Banco Master and the national political arena.
excerpt: André Mendonça takes center stage with Supreme Court investigations involving Banco Master and the Lulinha cases.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: O GLOBO, Hora do Povo, BNC Amazonas
contentHtml:
The investigations led by Justice André Mendonça in the Supreme Federal Court have become the center of attention in the national political arena. The reporting justice has sparked widespread public discussion due to the progress of inquiries involving Banco Master and the Lulinha case.

The justice's role in the Supreme Federal Court

André Mendonça serves as the reporting justice for two cases with the potential to influence the election outcome. Under his responsibility are the Master case, which has tarnished Flávio Bolsonaro's image, and two inquiries from the Lulinha case, which threatens the president's plans. The investigations are moving at different paces, sparking debates over how the proceedings are being handled.

The status of the Master case and Banco Master funds

The Master case involves the investigation into funds transferred by Daniel Vorcaro, from Banco Master, to finance the film Dark Horse, a project related to Jair Bolsonaro. Flávio Bolsonaro acknowledged having requested funds from Vorcaro for the project, and reports indicate that approximately R$ 61 million were transferred. The Prosecutor General's Office requested that the Lulinha case be sent to the first instance, but information attributed to interlocutors indicates that Mendonça will deny the request.

The debate on impartiality and transparency

Critics point out that the progress of the investigations demonstrates selectivity and differing paces between the cases. While the inquiry into Lulinha dominates the news with a series of leaks, the Master case remains without new leaks or recent search operations. The justice himself has promised to conduct all inquiries with technical rigor and impartiality, stating that corruption has no partisan color.

The demand for answers on financial flows

Experts and citizens are demanding clear answers regarding the origin and destination of the billion-dollar funds and million-dollar transfers under investigation. This demand gains relevance given the financial scale of Banco Master and investments made by institutions such as Amazonprev, reinforcing the need for transparency and equality in the application of the law.

With information from O GLOBO, Hora do Povo, BNC Amazonas.
